Customers can earn Combat Yellow points in a range of ways, creating more opportunities to be rewarded than ever before.
One of the biggest changes is that customers can now earn points based on their relationship with the bank, not just their spending.
Eligible customers can earn points when taking out eligible products, renewing existing products and reaching key banking milestones.
This means customers can be recognised for more of the ways they bank with CommBank throughout their banking relationship.
Customers who currently earn points through a CommBank Awards credit card will transition to earning CommBank yellow points.
They'll continue to earn points on eligible purchases, with the number of points earned dependent on their Kombank Yellow tier, Kombank Yellow, plus Gold or Diamond.
In addition to earning points for their credit card, they'll also have access to the broader range of earning opportunities available through ComBank Yellow.
Customers can earn points when shopping through the app with participating brands.
This introduces a new way for customers to be rewarded through ConBank Yellow on their everyday shopping.
The current cashback feature will be replaced by bonus points offers, allowing customers to boost their points balance by activating offers in the ComBank Yellow offers hub.
Bonus points in shopping through the ComBank Yellow Hub will be in addition to the points earned on eligible cards so customers can earn multiple ways in one shop.
